description: Field mapping and definitions for LeadCatch. Covers the AI extraction schema, HubSpot Contact properties, Firestore document shapes, and Note engagement structure.

extractionSchema.description: JSON schema enforced on every AI model call (ClaudeExtractor / GeminiExtractor). Low-confidence or non-lead results are logged only — never written to HubSpot.

firstname.description: Lead's first name extracted from the email body or signature.

lastname.description: Lead's last name extracted from the email body or signature.

email.description: Lead's email address. Will be extracted from the body and not the email headers.

phone.description: Lead's phone number, any format, as extracted. Null if not present.

message.description: The freeform buyer question or message, cleaned of boilerplate.

listing_reference.description: Structured reference to the vehicle or listing the lead is enquiring about. Null if the email has no listing context.

vin.description: Vehicle Identification Number (17-char alphanumeric) if present.

stock_number.description: Dealer stock number or inventory ID if present.

url.description: Full listing URL (e.g. cargurus.com/...listing/...) if present.

title.description: Human-readable listing title (e.g. '2022 Toyota Camry LE') if present.

referring_site.description: The classified site or source the listing is from, if it can be determined (e.g. 'CarGurus', 'AutoTrader').

year.description: Vehicle model year if it can be extracted.

make.description: Vehicle make (brand) if it can be extracted.

model.description: Vehicle model if it can be extracted.

is_actual_lead.description: True only when the email represents a genuine buyer enquiry. False for listing-view notifications, dealer-to-dealer messages, vendor outreach, and marketing noise.

confidence.description: Model confidence in the extraction. 'low' or 'medium + is_actual_lead=false' suppresses record creation.

standard.description: Built-in HubSpot Contact properties. Always upserted when a lead is matched.

email.note: Used as the upsert key for Contact deduplication.

custom.description: Custom properties registered under the 'inbox_agent' property group on app install (crm.schemas.contacts.write). All names are prefixed 'inbox_agent_'. Overwritten with the latest inquiry on every processed email.
custom.registeredBy: ensureInboxAgentProperties() called from OAuth callback; idempotent (409 = skip).

inbox_agent_lead_source.description: Specific source label for the most recent enquiry (e.g. 'CarGurus', 'Boat Trader', 'Dealer Site Form', 'Unknown'). Set by the source classifier.

inbox_agent_inquiry_message.description: Freeform buyer question or message from the most recent processed email.

inbox_agent_listing_ref.description: Serialized listing reference (VIN, year, make, model, and listing URL) from the most recent email. Null/empty if no listing context was extracted.

inbox_agent_processed_at.description: Timestamp of the most recently processed email for this Contact.

noteEngagement.description: One Note engagement posted per processed email via POST /crm/objects/2026-03/notes. Associated to the Contact at creation time via the associations array. Provides full inquiry history on the Contact timeline.

hs_note_body.description: Plain-text note body. Contains: source label, buyer message, listing reference, extraction confidence, and HubSpot Conversations thread URL.

hs_timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds at time of processing. Determines where the Note appears on the timeline.

contactId.description: HubSpot Contact record ID. Must be resolved from the upsert response before posting the Note.

firestore.description: Three top-level Firestore collections. All use native mode.

/portals/{portal_id}.description: One document per installed HubSpot portal. Created/updated during OAuth callback.

access_token.description: Current HubSpot OAuth access token for this portal.

refresh_token.description: HubSpot OAuth refresh token. Used to obtain a new access token when expired.

expires_at.description: Epoch ms when the access token expires. Refresh proactively before this time.

installed_at.description: Timestamp when the app was first installed on this portal.

app_id.description: HubSpot app ID — used to scope webhook and app-event operations.

/dedupeKeys/{dedupe_key}.description: Deduplication ledger. Key is email + listing_ref + bucketed_timestamp. Firestore TTL policy auto-expires documents after 24 h — no manual cleanup needed.
/dedupeKeys/{dedupe_key}.keyFormat: SHA-256 or deterministic hash of (email + listing_ref + time_bucket_epoch_ms)

portal_id.description: HubSpot portal ID the duplicate key belongs to.

message_id.description: HubSpot Conversations message ID that first triggered this dedupe key.

created_at.description: Creation time. Used by the Firestore TTL policy for 24 h auto-expiry.

/auditLog/{auto_id}.description: One document per webhook processed, regardless of outcome. Enables replay and human review.

portal_id.description: HubSpot portal ID the webhook came from.

message_id.description: HubSpot Conversations message ID from the webhook payload.

source_classified.description: Source label assigned by the source classifier (e.g. 'CarGurus', 'unknown').

extraction_json.description: The raw extraction schema object returned by the AI model.

confidence.description: Confidence value from the extraction, mirrored here for quick querying.

outcome.description: Result of processing: 'created' = new Contact; 'updated' = existing Contact upserted; 'skipped' = dedupe hit or non-lead; 'errored' = pipeline exception; 'queued-for-review' = low confidence, no record written.

hubspot_contact_id.description: HubSpot Contact record ID if a record was created or updated. Null on skip/error.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this audit log document was written.

sourceClassifier.description: Lightweight classifier that precedes the structured extractor. Maps each email to a known source or 'unknown'. Drives which extraction prompt/examples are used and sets inbox_agent_lead_source.

sourceLabel.description: Human-readable source name written to inbox_agent_lead_source.

confidence.description: 'heuristic' = matched via From: domain rule; 'model' = fell through to AI classifier.
